newsitem.title: UK: Euro feeds steady but quiet on holiday hit market.
newsitem.headline: Euro feeds steady but quiet on holiday hit market.

text.p: Brokers on the European feeds market report virtually no activity on Wednesday owing to the Queen's Day holiday in the Netherlands.
Prices, where quoted, were mostly higher but as expected no business developed.
South American soymeal was offered $1 to $5 up, while sunflowermeal was $1 higher.
Rapemeal ex-mill lower Rhine was 0.25 marks higher while the remainder of the market was unchanged.
Brokers expect a quiet end to the week with most of the rest of Europe closed on Thursday for May Day.
"A lot of people will make it into a long weekend," said one.
